governed.config: SwiftLint reads the project's .swiftlint.yml (enabled, disabled and opt-in rules, included and excluded paths): the project decides the rules; the tool only runs when that file exists

suppressions.description: honored: // swiftlint:disable comments (next, this, previous, and block forms)

en.label: SwiftLint (Swift)
en.purpose: The Swift linter: naming, spacing, line length, force unwraps, unused code and the style conventions of the Swift community, as the project's .swiftlint.yml sets them.
en.limitation: It runs only when the project has a .swiftlint.yml; it works on the source text and does not compile the code, so its analyzer-only rules are not run. It reports and never rewrites a file.
en.needs: Nothing beyond the tools image: no network and no project dependencies; about 1 GB of memory.

pt-BR.label: SwiftLint (Swift)
pt-BR.purpose: O linter de Swift: nomes, espaçamento, tamanho de linha, force unwraps, código não usado e as convenções de estilo da comunidade Swift, como o .swiftlint.yml do projeto define.
pt-BR.limitation: Só roda quando o projeto tem um .swiftlint.yml; trabalha sobre o texto do código e não o compila, então as regras que exigem análise do compilador não rodam. Relata e nunca reescreve um arquivo.
pt-BR.needs: Nada além da imagem de ferramentas: sem rede e sem as dependências do projeto; cerca de 1 GB de memória.
